question: Y is mother of B. B is married to C. X is father of C. J is the only son of X. K is the only child of J. How is B related to J?
solution:
Using the symbols in the table below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e70b8fc59f55523cbd1c0dcb6157cdd0120d14d1918de4106bf11139640dba2e.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5a98599be4fbe2b2d2f77f84bf7e5810ca439110a43e4873d38210a045a240ca.png] 

B is the brother-in-law of J.

Hence, **'brother-in-law' **is the correct answer.
